title: Lu Pulu
description: Tongan lu pulu combines corned beef, onion and coconut cream in a leaf parcel. This version replaces unavailable taro leaves with spinach and banana leaf.

steps.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C. Drain the canned corned beef and break into coarse chunks. Thinly slice onion.
Briefly wilt spinach in a pan, squeeze excess liquid, then toss with the corned beef and onion.
Line a casserole dish with food-safe banana leaves, spoon the mixture in and pour over coconut cream; close the leaves or cover tightly with a lid.
Bake covered for 45–55 minutes until thoroughly hot and bubbling. Unwrap cautiously and serve with cooked root vegetables.
